skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to analyze data and support decision-making using probability and statistical methods.
Understanding of probability concepts and distributions.
Knowledge of statistical methods and their applications in economics and business.
Ability to draw conclusions from data using statistical inference techniques.
Proficiency in using Excel for data analysis and statistical computations.
Basic proficiency in using R for statistical analysis.
Ability to make decisions based on statistical analysis and probability.
Developing the ability to learn independently and work collaboratively.
Enhancing critical thinking skills through statistical analysis.
Ability to write reports based on statistical analysis to support decision-making.
